stories.title: Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru begins another review of Senedd constituencies
stories.summary: A review of the Senedd constituencies covering Flintshire has been launched by the body responsible for setting Wales’s political boundaries. The Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru published its Guide to the 2030 Review on Wednesday. The current Fflint Wrecsam and Clwyd constituencies, which between them cover Flintshire, were created ahead of this year’s Senedd election

stories.title: Connah’s Quay High School clarifies uniform policy after sock colour confusion
stories.summary: Connah’s Quay High School has written to parents to clarify its uniform policy, after incorrect guidance about sock colour led to widespread reaction on social media. stories.title: Phosphate rules blocking small planning applications in Flintshire
stories.summary: Small planning applications across Flintshire are being refused because of phosphate pollution rules protecting the River Dee. A councillor has told a scrutiny committee that the problem is affecting small businesses across the county. Officers warned the wider issue could take up to three years to resolve. stories.title: Former Deeside Sixth student now inspiring young people at Gladstone’s Library
stories.summary: A former Coleg Cambria student who was among the first through the doors of Deeside Sixth is now helping inspire the next generation to engage with politics, history and democracy through her work at Gladstone’s Library.
